sections.label: Book 4
sections.name: The Soma sacrifice: consecration and purchase of Soma

verses.sa: एदमगन्म देवयजनं पृथिव्या यत्र देवासो अजुषन्त विश्वे। ऋक्सामाभ्यां संतरन्तो यजुर्भी रायस्पोषेण समिषा मदेम। इमा आपः शमु मे सन्तु देवी रोषधे त्रायस्व स्वधिते मैनं हिंसीः॥
verses.tr: edamaganma devayajanaṃ pṛthivyā yatra devāso ajuṣanta viśve ṛksāmābhyāṃ saṃtaranto yajurbhī rāyaspoṣeṇa samiṣā madema imā āpaḥ śamu me santu devī roṣadhe trāyasva svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīḥ
verses.en: We have reached this earth's place of sacrificing, the place wherein all Deities delighted. Crossing by Rik, by Saman, and by Yajus, may we rejoice in food and growth of riches. Gracious to me be these Celestial Waters! Protect me, Plant. O Knife, forbear to harm him.

verses.sa: आपो अस्मान्मातरः शुन्धयन्तु घृतेन नो घृतप्वः पुनन्तु। विश्वं हि रिप्रं प्रवहन्ति देवीरुदिदाभ्यः शुचिरा पूत एमि। दीक्षातपसोस्तनूरसि तां त्वा शिवां शग्मां परि दधे भद्रं वर्णं पुष्यन्॥
verses.tr: āpo asmānmātaraḥ śundhayantu ghṛtena no ghṛtapvaḥ punantu viśvaṃ hi ripraṃ pravahanti devīrudidābhyaḥ śucirā pūta emi dīkṣātapasostanūrasi tāṃ tvā śivāṃ śagmāṃ pari dadhe bhadraṃ varṇaṃ puṣyan
verses.en: The Mother Floods shall make us bright and shining, cleansers of holy oil, with oil shall cleanse us. For, Goddesses, they bear off all defilement. I rise up from them purified and brightened. The form of Consecration and of Fervour art thou. I put thee on, the kind and blissful, maintaining an agreeable appearance.

verses.sa: महीनां पयोऽसि वर्चोदा असि वर्चो मे देहि। वृत्रस्यासि कनीनकश्चक्षुर्दा असि चक्षुर्मे देहि॥
verses.tr: mahīnāṃ payo'si varcodā asi varco me dehi vṛtrasyāsi kanīnakaścakṣurdā asi cakṣurme dehi
verses.en: The Great Ones' milk art thou. Giver of splendour art thou: bestow on me the gift of splendour. Pupil art thou of Vritra's eye. The giver of eyes art thou. Give me the gift of vision.

verses.sa: चित्पतिर्मा पुनातु वाक्पतिर्मा पुनातु देवो मा सविता पुनात्वच्छिद्रेण पवित्रेण सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः। तस्य ते पवित्रपते पवित्रपूतस्य यत्कामः पुने तच्छकेयम्॥
verses.tr: citpatirmā punātu vākpatirmā punātu devo mā savitā punātvacchidreṇa pavitreṇa sūryasya raśmibhiḥ tasya te pavitrapate pavitrapūtasya yatkāmaḥ pune tacchakeyam
verses.en: Purify me the Lord of Thought! Purify me the Lord of Speech! Purify me God Savitar with perfect strainer, with the beams of Surya! Of thee, Lord of the Strainer! who art by the strainer purified, With what desire I purify myself, may I accomplish it.

verses.sa: आ वो देवास ईमहे वामं प्रयत्यध्वरे। आ वो देवास आशिषो यज्ञियासो हवामहे॥
verses.tr: ā vo devāsa īmahe vāmaṃ prayatyadhvare ā vo devāsa āśiṣo yajñiyāso havāmahe
verses.en: We come to you for precious wealth, O Gods, as sacrifice proceeds. O Gods, we call on you to give blessings that wait on sacrifice.

verses.sa: स्वाहा यज्ञं मनसः स्वाहोरोरन्तरिक्षात्स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां स्वाहा वातादारभे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: svāhā yajñaṃ manasaḥ svāhororantarikṣātsvāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ svāhā vātādārabhe svāhā
verses.en: Svaha! from mind the sacrifice. Svaha! from spacious firmament. Svadha! from Dyaus and Prithivi. Svaha! from Wind I seize. Svaha!

verses.sa: आकूत्यै प्रयुजेऽग्नये स्वाहा मेधायै मनसेऽग्नये स्वाहा दीक्षायै तपसेऽग्नये स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै पूष्णेऽग्नये स्वाहा। आपो देवीर्बृहतीर्विश्वशम्भुवो द्यावापृथिवी उरो अन्तरिक्ष। बृहस्पतये हविषा विधेम स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ākūtyai prayuje'gnaye svāhā medhāyai manase'gnaye svāhā dīkṣāyai tapase'gnaye svāhā sarasvatyai pūṣṇe'gnaye svāhā āpo devīrbṛhatīrviśvaśambhuvo dyāvāpṛthivī uro antarikṣa bṛhaspataye haviṣā vidhema svāhā
verses.en: To Resolution, Motive, Agni, Svaha! All-hail to Wisdom, and to Mind, and Agni! All-hail to Consecration, Fervour, Agni! Hail to Sarasvati, Pushan, and Agni! Ye vast, divine, all-beneficial Waters, ye Heaven and Earth and spacious Air between them, Let us adore Brihaspati with oblation. All-hail!

verses.sa: विश्वो देवस्य नेतुर्मर्तो वुरीत सख्यम्। विश्वो राय इषुध्यति द्युम्नं वृणीत पुष्यसे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: viśvo devasya neturmarto vurīta sakhyam viśvo rāya iṣudhyati dyumnaṃ vṛṇīta puṣyase svāhā
verses.en: May every mortal man elect the friendship of the guiding God. Each one solicits him for wealth: let him seek fame to prosper him.

verses.sa: ऋक्सामयोः शिल्पे स्थस्ते वामारभे ते मा पातमास्य यज्ञस्योदृचः। शर्मासि शर्म मे यच्छ नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीः॥
verses.tr: ṛksāmayoḥ śilpe sthaste vāmārabhe te mā pātamāsya yajñasyodṛcaḥ śarmāsi śarma me yaccha namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ
verses.en: Rik's, Saman's counterparts are ye. I touch you. Protect me till the sacrifice be ended. Thou art a place of refuge. Give me refuge. Obeisance unto thee! Forbear to harm me.

verses.sa: ऊर्गस्याङ्गिरस्यूर्णम्म्रदा ऊर्जं मयि धेहि। सोमस्य नीविरसि विष्णोः शर्मासि शर्म यजमानस्येन्द्रस्य योनिरसि सुसस्याः कृषीस्कृधि। उच्छ्रयस्व वनस्पत ऊर्ध्वो मा पाह्यंहस आस्य यज्ञस्योद्रचः॥
verses.tr: ūrgasyāṅgirasyūrṇammradā ūrjaṃ mayi dhehi somasya nīvirasi viṣṇoḥ śarmāsi śarma yajamānasyendrasya yonirasi susasyāḥ kṛṣīskṛdhi ucchrayasva vanaspata ūrdhvo mā pāhyaṃhasa āsya yajñasyodracaḥ
verses.en: Strength of Angirases art thou. Wool-soft, bestow thou strength on me. Thou art the garment-knot of Soma. Vishnu's refuge art thou, the Sacrificer's refuge. Thou art the womb of Indra. Make the crops produce abundant grain. Stand up erect, Tree. Protect me from harm until this sacrifice be ended.

verses.sa: व्रतं कृणुताग्निर्ब्रह्माग्निर्यज्ञो वनस्पतिर्यज्ञियः। दैवीं धियं मनामहे सुमृडीकामभिष्टये वर्चोधां यज्ञवाहसं सुतीर्था नो असद्वशे। ये देवा मनोजाता मनोयुजो दक्षक्रतवस्ते नोऽवन्तु ते नः पान्तु तेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vrataṃ kṛṇutāgnirbrahmāgniryajño vanaspatiryajñiyaḥ daivīṃ dhiyaṃ manāmahe sumṛḍīkāmabhiṣṭaye varcodhāṃ yajñavāhasaṃ sutīrthā no asadvaśe ye devā manojātā manoyujo dakṣakratavaste no'vantu te naḥ pāntu tebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Prepare ye vow-food. Agni is the Brahman, Agni is sacrifice, the tree is holy. For aid we meditate divine Intelligence, most merciful, Free-giver, bringing worship. May it guide us gently, as we would. Favour us Gods, mind-born, endowed with mind and intellectual might! All-hail to them! May they be our protectors.

verses.sa: श्वात्राः पीता भवत यूयमापो अस्माकमन्तरुदरे सुशेवाः। ता अस्मभ्यमयक्ष्मा अनमीवा अनागसः स्वदन्तु देवीरमृता ऋतावृधः॥
verses.tr: śvātrāḥ pītā bhavata yūyamāpo asmākamantarudare suśevāḥ tā asmabhyamayakṣmā anamīvā anāgasaḥ svadantu devīramṛtā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ
verses.en: Waters that we have drunk! become refreshing, become auspicious draughts within our belly. Free from all sin and malady and sickness, may they be pleasant to our taste, divine Ones, immortal, strengtheners of eternal Order.

verses.sa: इयं ते यज्ञिया तनूरपो मुञ्चामि न प्रजाम्। अंहोमुचः स्वाहाकृताः पृथिवीमा विशत पृथिव्या सम्भव॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ te yajñiyā tanūrapo muñcāmi na prajām aṃhomucaḥ svāhākṛtāḥ pṛthivīmā viśata pṛthivyā sambhava
verses.en: This is thy sacrificial form. Not offspring, waters I discharge. Freeing from sin and consecrate by Svaha enter ye the earth. Be thou united with the earth.

verses.sa: अग्ने त्वं सु जागृहि वयं सु मन्दिषीमहि। रक्षा णो अप्रयुच्छन् प्रबुधे नः पुनस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: agne tvaṃ su jāgṛhi vayaṃ su mandiṣīmahi rakṣā ṇo aprayucchan prabudhe naḥ punaskṛdhi
verses.en: O Agni, watch thou well. May we take joy in most refreshing sleep. Protect us with unceasing care. From slumber waken us again.

verses.sa: पुनर्मनः पुनरायुर्म आऽगन् पुनः प्राणः पुनरात्मा म आऽगन् पुनश्चक्षुः पुनः श्रोत्रं म आऽगन्। वैश्वानरो अदब्धस्तनूपा अग्निर्नः पातु दुरितादवद्यात्॥
verses.tr: punarmanaḥ punarāyurma ā'gan punaḥ prāṇaḥ punarātmā ma ā'gan punaścakṣuḥ punaḥ śrotraṃ ma ā'gan vaiśvānaro adabdhastanūpā agnirnaḥ pātu duritādavadyāt
verses.en: Thought hath returned to me, and life; my breath and soul have come again. Our bodies' guard, unscathed, Vaisvanara Agni preserve us from misfortune and dishonour.

verses.sa: त्वमग्ने व्रतपा असि देव आ मर्त्येष्वा। त्वं यज्ञेष्वीड्यः। रास्वेयत्सोमा भूयो भर देवो नः सविता वसोर्दाता वस्वदात्॥
verses.tr: tvamagne vratapā asi deva ā martyeṣvā tvaṃ yajñeṣvīḍyaḥ rāsveyatsomā bhūyo bhara devo naḥ savitā vasordātā vasvadāt
verses.en: Thou, Agni, art the guardian God of sacred vows among mankind, thou meet for praise at holy rites. Grant this much, Soma! bring yet more. God Savitar who giveth wealth hath given treasure unto us.

verses.sa: एषा ते शुक्र तनूरेतद्वर्चस्तया सम्भव भ्राजं गच्छ। जूरसि धृता मनसा जुष्टा विष्णवे॥
verses.tr: eṣā te śukra tanūretadvarcastayā sambhava bhrājaṃ gaccha jūrasi dhṛtā manasā juṣṭā viṣṇave
verses.en: This is thy form, O Bright One, this thy lustre. Combine with this thy form and go to splendour. Impetuous art thou, upheld by mind, and Vishnu loveth thee.

verses.sa: तस्यास्ते सत्यसवसः प्रसवे तन्वो यन्त्रमशीय स्वाहा। शुक्रमसि चन्द्रमस्यमृतमसि वैश्वदेवमसि॥
verses.tr: tasyāste satyasavasaḥ prasave tanvo yantramaśīya svāhā śukramasi candramasyamṛtamasi vaiśvadevamasi
verses.en: Moved by thine impulse who hast true impulsion, may I obtain a prop to stay my body. Pure art thou, glistering art thou, immortal, dear to all the Gods.

verses.sa: चिदसि मनासि धीरसि दक्षिणासि क्षत्रियासि यज्ञियास्यदितिरस्युभयतःशीर्ष्णी। सा नः सुप्राची सुप्रतीच्येधि मित्रस्त्वा पदि बध्नीतां पूषाऽध्वनस्पात्विन्द्रायाध्यक्षाय॥
verses.tr: cidasi manāsi dhīrasi dakṣiṇāsi kṣatriyāsi yajñiyāsyaditirasyubhayataḥśīrṣṇī sā naḥ suprācī supratīcyedhi mitrastvā padi badhnītāṃ pūṣā'dhvanaspātvindrāyādhyakṣāya
verses.en: Thought art thou, mind, intelligence, the Guerdon, royal, worshipful, Aditi with a double head. Succeed for us in going forth, succeed for us in thy return. May Mitra bind thee by the foot. May Pushan guard thy pathways for Indra whose eye is over all.

verses.sa: अनु त्वा माता मन्यतामनु पिताऽनु भ्राता सगर्भ्योऽनु सखा सयूथ्यः। सा देवि देवमच्छेहीन्द्राय सोमं रुद्रस्त्वा वर्त्तयतु स्वस्ति सोमसखा पुनरेहि॥
verses.tr: anu tvā mātā manyatāmanu pitā'nu bhrātā sagarbhyo'nu sakhā sayūthyaḥ sā devi devamacchehīndrāya somaṃ rudrastvā varttayatu svasti somasakhā punarehi
verses.en: Thy mother give thee leave to go, thy father, thine own brother, and thy friend of the same herd with thee! Go thou, O Goddess, to the God. To Soma go for Indra's sake. May Rudra turn thee back. Return safely with Soma as thy friend.

verses.sa: वस्व्यस्यदितिरस्यादित्यासि रुद्रासि चन्द्रासि। बृहस्पतिष्ट्वा सुम्ने रम्णातु रुद्रो वसुभिरा चके॥
verses.tr: vasvyasyaditirasyādityāsi rudrāsi candrāsi bṛhaspatiṣṭvā sumne ramṇātu rudro vasubhirā cake
verses.en: Thou art a Asvin!, thou art Aditi, thou art an Aditya, thou art a Rudra, thou art a Chandra. Brihaspati vouchsafe thee rest and comfort! Rudra with Vasus looks on thee with favour.

verses.sa: अदित्यास्त्वा मूर्धन्नाजिघर्मि देवयजने पृथिव्या इडायास्पदमासि घृतवत् स्वाहा। अस्मे रमस्वास्मे ते बन्धुस्त्वे रा यो मे रायो मा वयं रायस्पोषेण वियौष्म तोतो रायः॥
verses.tr: adityāstvā mūrdhannājigharmi devayajane pṛthivyā iḍāyāspadamāsi ghṛtavat svāhā asme ramasvāsme te bandhustve rā yo me rāyo mā vayaṃ rāyaspoṣeṇa viyauṣma toto rāyaḥ
verses.en: On Aditi's head I sprinkle thee, on the earth's place of sacrifice. Footstep of Ida art thou, filled with fatness. Hail! Rejoice in us. Thy kinship is in us. In thee are riches. Mine be riches! Let us not be deprived of abundant riches. Thine, thine are riches.

verses.sa: समख्ये देव्या धिया सं दक्षिणयोरुचक्षसा। मा म आयुः प्रमोषीर्मो अहं तव। वीरं विदेय तव देवि संदृशि॥
verses.tr: samakhye devyā dhiyā saṃ dakṣiṇayorucakṣasā mā ma āyuḥ pramoṣīrmo ahaṃ tava vīraṃ videya tava devi saṃdṛśi
verses.en: I with my thought have commerced with divine far-sighted Dakshina. Steal not my life. I will not thine. May I, Goddess, in thy sight find for myself a hero son.

verses.sa: एष ते गायत्रो भाग इति मे सोमाय ब्रूतादेष ते त्रैष्टुभो भाग इति मे सोमाय ब्रूतादेष ते जागतो भाग इति मे सोमाय ब्रूताच्छन्दोनामानां साम्राज्यं गच्छेति मे सोमाय ब्रूतादास्माकोऽसि शुक्रस्ते ग्रह्यो विचितस्त्वा वि चिन्वन्तु॥
verses.tr: eṣa te gāyatro bhāga iti me somāya brūtādeṣa te traiṣṭubho bhāga iti me somāya brūtādeṣa te jāgato bhāga iti me somāya brūtācchandonāmānāṃ sāmrājyaṃ gaccheti me somāya brūtādāsmāko'si śukraste grahyo vicitastvā vi cinvantu
verses.en: Tell Soma this for me: This is thy share allied with Gayatri. For me say this to Soma: This is thine allotted Trishtup share. Tell Soma this for me: This is thy share allied with Jagati. Tell Soma this for me: Win thou sole lordship of the metres' names. Ours art thou: pure thy juice for draught. Let separators pick thee out.

verses.sa: अभि त्यं देवं सवितारमोण्योः कविक्रतुमर्चामि सत्यसवं रत्नधामभि प्रियं मतिं कविम्। ऊर्ध्वा यस्यामतिर्भा अदिद्युतत्सवीमनि हिरण्यपाणिरमिमीत सुक्रतुः कृपा स्वः। प्रजाभ्यस्त्वा प्रजास्त्वा ऽनुप्राणन्तु प्रजास्त्वमनुप्राणिहि॥
verses.tr: abhi tyaṃ devaṃ savitāramoṇyoḥ kavikratumarcāmi satyasavaṃ ratnadhāmabhi priyaṃ matiṃ kavim ūrdhvā yasyāmatirbhā adidyutatsavīmani hiraṇyapāṇiramimīta sukratuḥ kṛpā svaḥ prajābhyastvā prajāstvā 'nuprāṇantu prajāstvamanuprāṇihi
verses.en: I sing my song of praise to him, Savitar, God between the Bowls, strong with the wisdom of the wise, of true impulsion, wealth-giver, the well-beloved thoughtful Sage. To him at whose in impulsion shone aloft in heaven the splendid light. Most wise, the Golden-handed hath measured the sky with skilled design. For living creatures, thee. Let living creatures breathe after thee. Breathe after living creatures.

verses.sa: शुक्रं त्वा शुक्रेण क्रीणामि चन्द्रं चन्द्रेणामृतममृतेन। सग्मे ते गोरस्मे ते चन्द्राणि तपसस्तनूरसि प्रजापतेर्वर्णः परमेण क्रीयसे सहस्रपोषं पुषेयम्॥
verses.tr: śukraṃ tvā śukreṇa krīṇāmi candraṃ candreṇāmṛtamamṛtena sagme te gorasme te candrāṇi tapasastanūrasi prajāpatervarṇaḥ parameṇa krīyase sahasrapoṣaṃ puṣeyam
verses.en: Thee who art pure, with what is pure I purchase, the bright with bright, immortal with immortal. The Sacrificer keep thy cow. Let thy gold pieces be with us. Fervour's form art thou, and Prajapati's nature. With the most noble animal art thou, purchased. May I increase with thousandfold abundance.

verses.sa: मित्रो न एहि सुमित्रध इन्द्रस्योरुमा विश दक्षिणमुशन्नुशन्तं स्योनः स्योनम्। स्वान भ्राजाङ्घारे बम्भारे हस्त सुहस्त कृशानवेते वः सोमक्रयणास्तान्रक्षध्वं मा वो दभन्॥
verses.tr: mitro na ehi sumitradha indrasyorumā viśa dakṣiṇamuśannuśantaṃ syonaḥ syonam svāna bhrājāṅghāre bambhāre hasta suhasta kṛśānavete vaḥ somakrayaṇāstānrakṣadhvaṃ mā vo dabhan
verses.en: As friend, the giver of good friends, approach us! Take thou thy seat on the right thigh of Indra, yearning on yearning, pleasing on the pleasing. Anghari, Svana, Bhuja, and Bambhari, O Hasta, and Suhasta and Krishna, These are your prices for the Soma purchase. Keep them securely, let them never fail you.

verses.sa: परि माग्ने दुश्चरिताद्बाधस्वा मा सुचरिते भज। उदायुषा स्वायुषोदस्थाममृताँ२ अनु॥
verses.tr: pari māgne duścaritādbādhasvā mā sucarite bhaja udāyuṣā svāyuṣodasthāmamṛtāṃ2 anu
verses.en: Keep me, O Agni, from unrighteous conduct: make me a sharer in the path of goodness. I, following Immortals, have arisen with longer life, with a good life before me.

verses.sa: प्रति पन्थामपद्महि स्वस्तिगामनेहसम्। येन विश्वाः परि द्विषो वृणक्ति विन्दते वसु॥
verses.tr: prati panthāmapadmahi svastigāmanehasam yena viśvāḥ pari dviṣo vṛṇakti vindate vasu
verses.en: Now have we entered on the path that leads to bliss without a foe, The path whereon a man escapes all enemies and gathers wealth.

verses.sa: अदित्यास्त्वगस्यदित्यै सद आसीद। अस्तभ्नाद्द्यां वृषभो अन्तरिक्षममिमीत वरिमाणं पृथिव्याः। आऽसीदद्विश्वा भुवनानि सम्राड्विश्वेत्तानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि॥
verses.tr: adityāstvagasyadityai sada āsīda astabhnāddyāṃ vṛṣabho antarikṣamamimīta varimāṇaṃ pṛthivyāḥ ā'sīdadviśvā bhuvanāni samrāḍviśvettāni varuṇasya vratāni
verses.en: The skin of Aditi art thou. Sit on the lap of Aditi. The Bull hath propped the sky and air's mid-region, the compass of the broad earth hath he measured. He, King Supreme, approached all living creatures. Truly all these are Varuna's ordinances.

verses.sa: वनेषु व्यन्तरिक्षं ततान वाजमर्वत्सु पय उस्रियासु। हृत्सु क्रतुं वरुणो विक्ष्वग्निं दिवि सूर्यमदधात् सोममद्रौ॥
verses.tr: vaneṣu vyantarikṣaṃ tatāna vājamarvatsu paya usriyāsu hṛtsu kratuṃ varuṇo vikṣvagniṃ divi sūryamadadhāt somamadrau
verses.en: Over the woods the air hath he extended, put milk in kine and vigorous speed in horses, Set intellect in hearts and fire in houses, Surya in heaven and Soma on the mountain.

verses.sa: सूर्यस्य चक्षुरारोहाग्नेरक्ष्णः कनीनकम्। यत्रैत्रशेभिरीयसे भ्राजमानो विपश्चिता॥
verses.tr: sūryasya cakṣurārohāgnerakṣṇaḥ kanīnakam yatraitraśebhirīyase bhrājamāno vipaścitā
verses.en: Ascend the eye of Surya, mount the pupil set in Agni's eye Where, radiant through the Wise One, thou speedest along with dappled steeds.

verses.sa: उस्रावेतं धूर्षाहौ युज्येथामनश्रू अवीरहणौ ब्रह्मचोदनौ। स्वस्ति यजमानस्य गृहान् गच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: usrāvetaṃ dhūrṣāhau yujyethāmanaśrū avīrahaṇau brahmacodanau svasti yajamānasya gṛhān gacchatam
verses.en: Approach, ye oxen, fit to bear the yoke; be yoked without a tear. Slaying no man, urging the Brahman forward, go happily to the Sacrificer's dwelling.

verses.sa: भद्रो मेऽसि प्रच्यवस्व भुवस्पते विश्वान्यभि धामानि। मा त्वा परिपरिणो विदन् मा त्वा परिपन्थिनो विदन् मा त्वा वृका अघायवो विदन्। श्येनो भूत्वा परा पत यजमानस्य गृहान् गच्छ तन्नौ सस्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: bhadro me'si pracyavasva bhuvaspate viśvānyabhi dhāmāni mā tvā paripariṇo vidan mā tvā paripanthino vidan mā tvā vṛkā aghāyavo vidan śyeno bhūtvā parā pata yajamānasya gṛhān gaccha tannau saskṛtam
verses.en: Lord of the World, thou art my gracious helper: move forward on thy way to all the stations. Let not opponents, let not robbers find thee, let not malignant wolves await thy coming. Fly thou away having become a falcon. Go to the dwelling of the Sacrificer. That is the special place for us to rest in.

verses.sa: नमो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य चक्षसे महो देवाय तदृतं सपर्यत। दूरेदृशे देवजाताय केतवे दिवस्पुत्राय सूर्याय शंसत॥
verses.tr: namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣase maho devāya tadṛtaṃ saparyata dūredṛśe devajātāya ketave divasputrāya sūryāya śaṃsata
verses.en: Do homage unto Varuna's and Mitra's eye: offer this solemn worship to the Mighty God, Who seeth far away, the Ensign born of Gods. Sing praises unto Surya, to the Son of Dyaus.

verses.sa: वरुणस्योत्तम्भनमसि वरुणस्य स्कम्भसर्जनी स्थो वरुणस्य ऋतसदन्यसि वरुणस्य ऋतसदनमसि वरुणस्य ऋतसदनमा सीद॥
verses.tr: varuṇasyottambhanamasi varuṇasya skambhasarjanī stho varuṇasya ṛtasadanyasi varuṇasya ṛtasadanamasi varuṇasya ṛtasadanamā sīda
verses.en: Thou art a prop for Varuna to rest on. Ye are the pins that strengthen Varuna's pillar. Thou art the lawful seat where Varuna sitteth. Sit on the lawful seat where Varuna sitteth.

verses.sa: या ते धामानि हविषा यजन्ति ता ते विश्वा परिभूरस्तु यज्ञम्। गयस्फ़ानः प्रतरणः सुवीरोऽवीरहा प्र चरा सोम दुर्यान्॥
verses.tr: yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti tā te viśvā paribhūrastu yajñam gayasfānaḥ prataraṇaḥ suvīro'vīrahā pra carā soma duryān
verses.en: Such of thy glories as with poured oblations men honour, may they all invest our worship. Wealth-giver, further with troops of heroes, sparing the brave, come, Soma, to our houses.
